provider.name: Link-only camera providers
provider.description: Camera networks that are unambiguously and intentionally published by their operators, but where this build could not confirm a permission to embed, or could not confirm a specific stable feed URL, or both. Each entry links out to the operator's own page. That is the safe default: the reader knowingly navigates to the operator, we make no outbound call, and we misrepresent nobody's licence. Each of these is a candidate for promotion to an embedding entry once a licence clause and a stable URL are confirmed.
provider.licence: Varies by operator — see each entry
provider.rateLimitNotes: No outbound calls are made for these entries. The registry metadata is authored, not fetched.

cameras.name: Norwegian Public Roads Administration road cameras (network index)
cameras.locationLabel: Norway — national road network (index entry, not a single camera). Coordinates are the approximate centroid of coverage.
cameras.embedNotes: Not embedded, because no stable per-camera image URL was confirmed during this build. The licence itself is favourable: the dataset is published under NLOD, the Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data, and is distributed as DATEX II XML together with WFS and WMS services. Cameras are placed at mountain passes, exposed sections, car parks and ferry connections, with update frequency varying by camera type. Promote to an embedding entry once a per-camera image URL and the NLOD attribution string are confirmed against the operator's dataset page.
cameras.attribution: Contains data under the Norwegian licence for Open Government data (NLOD) distributed by Statens vegvesen.
cameras.subject: traffic
cameras.confidenceNotes: The dataset, its NLOD licence and its DATEX II / WFS / WMS distribution were confirmed through the operator's own data portal listing on 2026-08-31, but the dataset page itself was not fetched and no individual camera endpoint was resolved — which is why this is a link-only entry. The attribution string is the credit template the NLOD licence itself specifies, 'Contains data under the Norwegian licence for Open Government data (NLOD) distributed by [name of licensor]', with Statens vegvesen substituted as licensor. Two things about it are not confirmed and must be before any embed: which NLOD version applies to this dataset, and whether Statens vegvesen has specified an alternative attribution form, which the licence expressly permits a licensor to do and which would then override this template. The NLOD text itself could not be fetched during this build (HTTP 406); the template wording comes from the published licence text as surfaced in search.

cameras.name: Swedish Transport Administration road cameras (network index)
cameras.locationLabel: Sweden — national road network (index entry, not a single camera). Coordinates are the approximate centroid of coverage.
cameras.embedNotes: Not embedded, because image URLs are obtainable only through the authenticated API at request time and no stable static URL was confirmed. The licence is permissive — information in Trafikverket's open API for traffic information is licensed under Creative Commons CC0, a public-domain dedication with no attribution obligation — so embedding would be lawful once a URL is established. An API key, obtained free from Trafikverket's data portal, is required. Note the convention used throughout this registry: embedPermitted is false whenever embedUrl is null, so a false value here reflects the absence of a confirmed URL and not a restriction in the licence.
cameras.subject: traffic
cameras.confidenceNotes: The CC0 licence on the open traffic information API and the requirement for a free API key were confirmed on 2026-08-31 through Trafikverket's own service pages and the Trafiklab API listing, but the terms page was not fetched directly and no camera endpoint was resolved.

cameras.name: Windy webcam network (network index)
cameras.locationLabel: Global — syndicated tourism, mountain and coastal webcams (index entry, not a single camera). Coordinates are nominal.
cameras.embedNotes: Not embedded in this build, because Windy's terms permit embedding only of image URLs returned by the Webcams API itself, and no such URL can be recorded statically here. The terms are otherwise workable: they permit displaying webcam images provided you use only URLs the API supplies, link every image to Windy, and link every image to the webcam page or timelapse player for the full view; attribution must be rendered near the images in the site's normal text size and colour, in the form 'Webcams provided by windy.com'. Bandwidth load must be reasonable and data used as delivered. An API key is required. This is a strong candidate for a runtime-resolved connector rather than a static registry entry.
cameras.licence: Proprietary — Windy Webcams API specific terms of use
cameras.subject: tourism
cameras.confidenceNotes: The embedding, linking and attribution conditions were established on 2026-08-31 from Windy's published Webcams API terms as summarised in search results, but the terms page itself was not fetched and the exact attribution markup requirement was not read verbatim. Because these terms impose linking obligations on every displayed image, they must be read in full before any Windy imagery is displayed. Nominal 0,0 coordinates mark this as a global index entry with no location.

cameras.name: Washington State DOT highway cameras (network index)
cameras.locationLabel: Washington State, USA — statewide highway network (index entry, not a single camera). Coordinates are the approximate centroid of coverage.
cameras.embedNotes: Not embedded. WSDOT's Traveler Information API provides statewide camera snapshots (stills only, no video) but requires an assigned access code, and the published terms encountered during this build address warranty disclaimer and indemnification rather than granting an explicit right to redisplay imagery. No embedding permission was confirmed, so the link-out default applies. Note the indemnity: the data user must hold harmless and indemnify WSDOT against liability arising from the user's use of the data — a clause that should be read by counsel before any integration, not only before any embed.

cameras.subject: traffic
cameras.confidenceNotes: The API, its camera endpoint, the snapshot-only limitation, the access-code requirement and the indemnification clause were confirmed on 2026-08-31 through WSDOT's own API documentation as surfaced in search results. The full terms page was not fetched, so the absence of a redisplay grant is an absence of confirmation rather than a confirmed prohibition.

cameras.name: US National Park Service webcams (network index)
cameras.locationLabel: United States — national parks (index entry, not a single camera). Coordinates are the approximate centroid of coverage.
cameras.embedNotes: Not embedded. The NPS publishes several hundred webcams across the park system and much NPS-produced media is in the US public domain, but the agency's own guidance is explicit that copyright status varies by item, that not all content on NPS sites was created or is owned by the NPS, and that some content is subject to third-party copyright, trademark, publicity, privacy or contractual restrictions. Because the status must be checked per item and could not be established generally, no blanket embedding permission is recorded. Individual park cameras may qualify for promotion after a per-camera check.

cameras.name: Rijkswaterstaat traffic cameras (public viewer)
cameras.locationLabel: Netherlands — national road network (index entry, not a single camera). Coordinates are the approximate centroid of coverage.
cameras.embedNotes: Not embedded, and flagged for review rather than treated as settled. Rijkswaterstaat operates an openly accessible public traffic camera viewer, and Rijkswaterstaat and NDW both publish substantial open traffic data. However, Rijkswaterstaat's own published position on camera imagery is that images from state roads and waterways are not made available to the public unless there is a statutory basis, and personal data collected for traffic-engineering research is not shared with third parties. Those two facts are in tension and this build could not resolve them. Until they are resolved, link-out only, and no assertion is made about what the imagery may be used for.
cameras.subject: traffic
cameras.confidenceNotes: Specifically uncertain: whether the imagery shown in the public viewer at the sourceUrl is published under any reuse licence at all. The operator's stated policy that camera imagery is not released to the public appears to conflict with the existence of the public viewer, and neither page was fetched directly during this build. This entry must not be promoted to embedding, and should not be published at all, until someone reads Rijkswaterstaat's actual terms for this viewer. It is retained here rather than omitted so the open question is visible rather than lost.
